subtitle_ja: 弱点を問題数で鍛えるTOEIC特訓
notes: Do not commit account-specific signing credentials.
The real Xcode application target is subjects/english/power-toeic-ios/AppShell/PowerTOEICApp.xcodeproj and unsigned release/archive regression is covered by CI.
The App Store privacy declaration must match the shipping binary. Current implementation collects no data off-device and uses UserDefaults for app-local state only.
Release/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is the canonical privacy manifest and the app-target copy must remain byte-for-byte synchronized.
SubmissionReadiness.json is the machine-checkable source for repository blockers and external operator inputs.
